pr_body:
The original issue with headers not being flushed when send in CONTINUATION frame was already fixed in #39166

This PR:
- Adds tests for long headers and one extra test for H/2 following closely the bug repro from #860.
- Fixes our H1.1 loopback server not properly handling long data exceeding the original buffer size.
- Fixed [integer decoding](https://http2.github.io/http2-spec/compression.html#integer.representation) in H/2 loopback (swapped order of LSB <-> MSB)

Closes #860 
Fixes #1496

issue_context.title: HTTP2 code coverage: add tests that cause us to send a CONTINUATION frame
issue_context.body:
See code here, line 1096: file://clrmain/public/writable/users/geoffrek/http2codecoverage/System.Net.Http_Http2Connection.htm#file0_line1035

To force a CONTINUATION frame, we need to send a header block > max frame size, i.e. 16K.

review_comments: We should add a comment here explaining that this is intentionally larger than 16K in total because that's the limit that will trigger a CONTINUATION frame in HTTP2.
It might be worth it to assert that we aren't setting any other flags here aside from EndHeaders.
